definitions.REL_INC: For a post-RFG component, replace each residual cell's absolute row by its gravity depth above that column's current frontier; preserve residual hyperedge identity, owner, shared-column incidence, and canonicalize under local column permutations.
definitions.CAP6_REL_INC: REL_INC plus the component's remaining local capacity modulo 6.

findings.statement: Outcome-independent GF(2) elimination reduces the raw exact pair catalogs to 37, 422, and 472 genuinely new quadratic directions on 5x3-k3, 4x4-k4, and fresh 6x3-k3 respectively, with exact scalar decoding preserved.

The DELAY descriptor alone spans the full observed quadratic interaction subspace on 5x3-k3 and 6x3-k3, showing that absolute component identity is unnecessary there once residual release depths are retained.

On 4x4-k4, DELAY captures 398 of 422 interaction dimensions and leaves 94 scalar contradictions; adding the sorted height multiset changes nothing. The missing information is therefore not raw elevation but residual/column incidence correlation.

REL_INC has zero scalar contradictions on 5x3-k3, 4x4-k4, and 6x3-k3. On 4x4-k4 it spans only 295 of 422 full structural interaction dimensions, proving that scalar-exact interaction coordinates can be strictly coarser than the full observed degree-2 structural feature space.

CAP6_REL_INC restores the complete observed quadratic interaction span on all three demanding carriers with zero scalar contradictions, giving an outcome-independent geometry-derived generator for the tested degree-2 interaction space.
Frozen REL_INC transfers unchanged to complete fresh 3x7-k3 and spans all six observed quadratic interaction dimensions with zero scalar contradictions.

The fresh 3x7-k3 carrier has zero degree-1 contradictions, so it qualifies structural transfer of REL_INC but does not independently establish that quadratic terms are value-necessary on that geometry.

The tested scalar evaluator does not require the full structural interaction space: REL_INC is Q-V sufficient where CAP6_REL_INC is needed to reproduce every observed degree-2 structural direction on 4x4-k4.

The next evaluator question is no longer whether arbitrary pair identities are needed; it is whether the exact-rank dependence and fitted GF(2)^2 coefficients can be reduced to a phase-graded quadratic law over REL_INC pair classes.

nonclaims: REL_INC is not proved Q-A or Q-F sufficient.
3x7-k3 does not prove quadratic necessity because degree one is already scalar-consistent there.
No closed-form coefficient law has yet been derived.
next_question: Can exact-rank quadratic GF(2)^2 decoding be replaced by a phase-graded (rank mod 3 plus mover parity / mod 6) quadratic law over frozen REL_INC pair classes?
